note: Regulatory fees on US equities as Alpaca passes them through, effective-dated. The open-ended rows are Alpaca's Brokerage Fee Schedule revised 2026-09-17, confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-26: SEC 0.0000206 x trade value (sells), FINRA TAF 0.000195 per share (sells, max 9.79 per trade), CAT 0.000003 per share (buys and sells). Earlier rows are the rates in force before them (SEC advisories, FINRA fee schedule). Rounding is the cost level's (D12, owner-confirmed): each fee type aggregated daily per account and rounded up to the cent at the optimistic and central levels, rounded up per order at the pessimistic level. Every fee type must be covered without gaps, and its last row is open-ended: a rate applies until the schedule changes. FINRA has scheduled TAF 0.000232 (max 11.61) from 2027-01-01; update when Alpaca's schedule does. Hashed into every experiment's manifest. Rows before 2023 (added 2026-10-01 for the long-term core, design §1) are the SEC Section 31 and FINRA TAF rates in force then, as regulatory fees; Alpaca passes these through, and its own pass-through practice before its 2018 brokerage launch is not modelled separately. FINRA paused the TAF (rate zero) from 2026-10-01 through 2026-12-31 (SR-FINRA-2026, Federal Register 2026-09-23); whether Alpaca passes the pause through is unconfirmed and no backtest window reaches it, so the open-ended TAF row is unchanged: revisit before core paper trading. Rows carry an optional asset_class (default equity); coverage is checked per fee and asset class. The crypto row is Alpaca's tier-1 taker fee (market orders take liquidity) from its schedule effective 2023-03-13; Alpaca publishes no earlier crypto schedule, so the 2023 rate is applied from 2021-01-01, an assumption stated here. Alpaca charges it in the received asset; it is modelled as a fraction of USD principal.

sources.finra_taf: https://www.finra.org/rules-guidance/rule-filings/sr-finra-2024-019/fee-adjustment-schedule (0.000166/share max 8.30 in 2024-2025; 0.000195 max 9.79 in 2026; from January 1 of each year)
sources.alpaca_schedule: https://files.alpaca.markets/disclosures/library/BrokFeeSched.pdf, revised 2026-09-17: SEC 0.0000206 x trade value, TAF 0.000195/share max 9.79, CAT 0.000003 per executed equivalent share on buys and sells; 'Each fee type is aggregated separately at the daily, per-account level. After aggregation, each fee total is rounded up to the nearest cent'
sources.alpaca_support: https://alpaca.markets/support/regulatory-fees, dated February 2026: SEC fee 'rounded up to the nearest penny'; TAF 'applied on a per-trade basis, rounded up to the nearest penny, and capped'
sources.cat_history: FINRA Rule 6897 lists industry-member CAT fees from September 2024 at 0.000009-0.000035 per share; how Alpaca passed them through before its current 0.000003 is not published, so the current rate is used from 2024-01-01. Before 2024 no CAT fee was assessed on industry members, so the row before it is an explicit zero, not a gap. At these order sizes the rate is immaterial next to rounding.
